about: Places shown under Explore on borneosky.com. Edited by hand. `town` is the gateway town whose page and notices we link to, usually the nearest; Mulu and Bario use Miri, where their flights leave (scripts/test_places.py checks it exists, shares the time zone and is within 260 km: a few deep-interior parks are far from any town on our list); `airport` is set only for airports on our flight boards. `kind` picks which weather matters most: sea (boat trips), mountain (early climbs), forest (trails), town (walking about), culture (mostly indoors: museums, mosques, temples, longhouses). The site keeps a copy in src/data/places.json.
